compiler.root_cause: LinkedIn personal used Composio direct, while LinkedIn company still fell through to the generic Buffer transport; Buffer rate-limit handling could also write LinkedIn state.

historical_replay: Buffer 429 could defer linkedin_company even when Composio LinkedIn was available.
linkedin_personal already proved the direct Composio publish-plus-readback pattern.

prevention.prevention_rule: Both LinkedIn channels must terminate in explicit Composio branches before any Buffer fallback. Buffer circuit state must never mutate LinkedIn delivery state.
regression_contract: Require exact LinkedIn provider readback before published state.
Fail closed on Composio/auth/readback failure; never issue a replacement post through Buffer.
Preserve single-writer publication capability and daily channel fence.
